spanish: Y era como entrar Moisés a la tienda, descendía columna de la nube, y se paraba en la abertura de la tienda, y hablaba con Moisés.

findings.issue: The construct chain with definite הֶעָנָן is definite, while bare “columna” can read as indefinite.
Unmarked “en” smooths the bare place complement of עמד plus פֶּתַח; no preposition token is present.

notes: Habitual imperfects match יֵרֵד and the following sequential perfects; the named participants and speech phrase stay within the tokens.
